comparison.objective: Press-fit a single-stud brick onto a 2×2 base, lift the assembly by the upper brick, then set it down.
comparison.physical_skill: Stud alignment, force-controlled press fitting, and validation of connection strength through lifting.
comparison.success_condition: The blocks remain joined while lifted by the upper brick, then are set down and released; calibrated physical-fit thresholds are not supplied.
comparison.reason: Both involve force and retention, but this tests successful press-fit joining and load-bearing attachment rather than intentional notch fracture while preserving a neighboring insert.
